name: Common
description: The trade tongue of the broken realm. Everyone speaks it; nobody loves it.

name: Old Imperial
description: The dead empire's court speech. Scholars, priests, and forgers of old documents keep it alive.

name: Hill Tongue
description: The talk of the herding clans beyond the walls. Blunt, practical, and full of weather.

name: Crypt Cant
description: A whispering argot of grave-robbers, cultists, and worse. Knowing it says something about you.
